title: One conditional clean timing replication after host suspension
registration_state: Outcome-blind; original and replication quality outcomes remain unopened until replication closure or an explicit wholly-unexecuted decision.
reason: Repeated host suspension invalidated the original wall-time endpoint: approximately 300 UTC seconds elapsed while the performance clock advanced approximately 2.4 seconds. No original time is repaired or removed.
original_data_preservation: Retain every original manifest, raw attempt, output, assigned question, physical cost and timing observation unchanged. Task14 and Task15 retain their separate original identities.

previous_settings.representatives: All eleven frozen family representatives, in addition to the frozen anchor, random mixture, oracle source and four primary paired executions.
previous_settings.operational_realization_path: Original run's existing index-realization.json; preserve unchanged.

new_settings.roster: Selected A* and B*, two fresh direct/cache-none repetitions each, plus unchanged FIXED-10 anchor, random mixture and FIXED-2 oracle source through the original scheduler.
new_settings.operational_realization_path: New run's own index-realization.json, binding its new scientific digests and the unchanged shared physical index.

unchanged.sample: Copy original sample.json bytes exactly; same 480 questions/order/tasks/document hash, population N=7344, algorithm and seed271828. No resampling or additional independent examples.
unchanged.hypothesis: The frozen PRE-OUTCOME-GBM candidate A* improves complete warm pipeline time per successful answer while preserving the preregistered quality guards against selected B* and FIXED-10.
unchanged.comparison: The original selected B* remains the primary comparator. No superiority-to-all-families claim; this reduced roster is a selected-comparison timing replication.
unchanged.settings: All selected policy identities, local model manifests, reader/model/prompt/chat-template/decoding identities, token caps, timeout, encoder, retrieval algorithm, random probability, seeds, two paired timing repetitions and statistical rules remain exactly equal to the parent.
unchanged.inference: Preserve all four quality guards, repeat-output parity, minimum-success rules, full assigned denominator, finite-population analysis, leave-one-out and documented stationarity/influence requirements. Repetitions and the same questions in another run are not independent new questions. No automatic validity=True.

operational_gate.launch: Source review and manifest verification do not authorize launch. Root must separately record original closure/stop, no concurrent model/index workload, a measured prospective budget including setup/final in-flight job/closure, and established awake conditions. Measured feasibility must fit entirely before the collection deadline and preserve the report reserve; it can impose an earlier actual latest start than the declared 08:12:52 UTC ceiling. The inherited original forecast is provenance only; it does not certify the new schedule's feasibility.
operational_gate.awake_evidence: Root audits prospective and continuing UTC, sampler and OS sleep/wake evidence. A request to the user to keep the host awake is not evidence by itself. Unknown awake coverage cannot establish a clean wall-time endpoint. No power setting, privileged memory limit or thermal-protection bypass.
operational_gate.no_fit_or_awake_evidence: Wholly unexecuted; no smaller subset, changed sample, one-repeat fallback or extension.
operational_gate.suspension_after_launch: Any verified suspension invalidates the new wall-time endpoint. Retain all assigned questions and all physical costs. No selective removal, clock repair, favorable rerun, third attempt or significance-driven extension.

physical_costs.local_work: Namespace new native launches, setup, worker reloads and jobs by (protocol_hash, resolved_run_dir, local_source_or_job_id), because confirmation run_id, job_id and task14-launch source strings can recur across roots.
physical_costs.shared_index: Preserve original index completion attempt and original owner protocol/root. Deduplicate that same physical index construction once across reports. A native seal's new_physical_source_id label alone does not imply a new index build. Charge each new run's actual index load/setup time separately.
physical_costs.execution_identity: Use new native environment, source snapshot, execution and launch receipts when actually created by the unchanged runtime. A prospective manifest is not a completed execution receipt.
